snippet.title: Orange Roulette - [Walkthrough]
snippet.description:
Trapped in a prison hell, a desperate orange will play a deadly game in the hopes of getting shipped home. Choose carefully and you might just get out of this without making the floor all sticky.

This video contains intense and graphic violence from a video game. The content is intended strictly for entertainment purposes and may not be suitable for all audiences. Viewer discretion is advised.
